parameters.name: Aggregator
parameters.description:
The aggregators. You can use one or more aggregators to query instance aggregate information.

Valid values:
- ACS:Application.Name
- ACS:Application.Version

sub_parameters.name: Name
sub_parameters.description: The property name of the component (N ranges from 1 to 5). Different components have different internal property names. Use [GetInventorySchema](https://api.aliyun.com/#/?product=oos&version=2019-06-01&api=GetInventorySchema) to query the property names of different components. For example, the ACS:InstanceInformation component has a property named InstanceId, so you set this parameter to ACS:InstanceInformation.InstanceId.

sub_parameters.name: Operator
sub_parameters.description:
The comparison operator for the component property query value (N ranges from 1 to 5).

Valid values:
- Equal
- NotEqual
- BeginWith
- LessThan
- GreaterThan

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The list of component property query values.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The page size. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 50.
